summary: BI-8CFA1CA8. Add AgentModelConfig.residencyPolicy (local_only|approved_cloud|any_enabled, nullable; null reads as any_enabled) so an agent's data-residency guarantee is stated rather than inferred from pinnedProviderId == 'local'. Previously one portal control carried two unrelated decisions: clearing a provider preference silently relaxed a residency guarantee and choosing 'local' from a routing dropdown silently imposed one. Additive and non-destructive; the migration backfills 'local_only' only for configs that are currently local-pinned and therefore already routed local_only, so behaviour on existing installs is unchanged. Composes with the per-task-type TaskRequirement.residencyPolicy as before — the stricter of the two wins. Stored as text to match the existing representation of the same axis on TaskRequirement; typing the whole residency axis as a Prisma enum is deliberately left to a separate change so the axis does not carry two representations mid-flight. Migration: 20260918100000_agent_model_config_residency_policy.

fields.name: residencyPolicy
fields.reason: Declares where an agent's inference may be executed — local hardware only, approved cloud providers, or any enabled provider. It is a data-residency control, not personal data: it constrains which providers may receive the agent's prompts and tool payloads. Enforced in routing as a hard fence, so it must be explicit and auditable rather than derived from an unrelated routing preference.
fields.provenance: Operator-set on the agent's model configuration. Backfilled once from the pre-existing inference (pinnedProviderId = 'local') to preserve current behaviour; no external source thereafter.
